Open Questions.value:
Work Status for solo founder-creatives (your question). Three options:

A) Treat solo operators as Freelance. A 1-person studio whose principal still does the work is functionally a freelancer; reserve "Studio" for teams of 2+. Simplest, no schema change. Julen (solo, still creates) becomes Freelance.

B) Keep "Studio" but use Autonomy + AI Notes to flag hands-on vs directs-only. Studio stays the label for anyone who founded/runs a practice; the does-he-still-make question lives in the note.

C) Add a new option (e.g. "Founder") to split the maker-founder from the manages-only founder. Needs a Notion option add.

My recommendation: A. It captures your point (Julen is basically a freelancer), keeps the schema clean, puts the founder framing in AI Notes, and catches a director-who-doesn't-make via Work With? + Autonomy rather than Work Status. If you pick A, I will set him to Freelance and apply the rule DB-wide (solo = Freelance, Studio = 2+ team). Which option?
